verdict.rationale: Abacum's own Excel connector is documented as letting users "push and pull data" between Excel and Abacum, so some data can be moved out into spreadsheets. Nothing shows a full-account export, open formats such as CSV or JSON, or an exit path that covers models, assumptions and history. Missing for 10: documented bulk export of all data, open-format export options (CSV/JSON/API), export of model logic and audit history, and independent or hands-on corroboration of data portability.
